classificationNotes: Source-draft Void Horrors are treated as a progressively unresolved absence-and-fracture visual and encounter-production family. Claims about extradimensional origin, ontology, intent, cognition, agency, personhood, and hostility remain proposals pending taxonomy review.
visualConstants: Rough humanoid or many-limbed absence retains edges that fail to close while proportions shift only within readable tier silhouettes.
Matte void black, negative space, purple-black, star flecks, and one bounded cold eye accent remain source grammar rather than affinity evidence.
Absence, non-reflection, star-field interior, fractured geometry, eye rings, and geometric shards never resolve into ordinary flesh or matter.
Power subtracts coherence: later forms occupy less resolvable physical presence while telegraph anchors become deliberately sparse.
escalationAxis: Coherence is progressively subtracted from a thin-limbed crawler until the sovereign is an unresolved world-shaped absence with one readable eye-ring system.

constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity negative space, void black, star flecks, cold eye accent, fractured geometry, and non-reflection remain source-supported absence, interior, accent, deformation, and optical behavior—not Fire, Earth, Wind, Water, or any other affinity.
Open edges, missing spans, shifting proportions, eye rings, and geometric shards preserve absence instead of filling it with ordinary matter.
normal.counterplaySignal: The established limb pause, face-hole rim, eye orbit gap, partial edge, or sovereign eye-ring break remains readable.
forbidden: Resolving absence into ordinary material for spectacle

constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 faceless thin limbs, missing edge, and no reflection gain one external ember bracket; T2 the face-hole rim gains a ceramic heat gate; T3 the eye orbit and star interior gain cooling brackets; T4 the partial contour and negative limb gain bounded heat markers; T5 the eye-ring and unresolved absence gain one external ignition interval.

Motion/process branches: T1 the thin-limb missing edge opens one external combustion cycle without filling the absence; T2 the face-hole rim exhausts through its heat gate; T3 eye orbit pauses cool the star-interior brackets; T4 the partial negative limb redirects smoke between markers; T5 the unresolved eye-ring ignites and cools one interval.
fire.counterplaySignal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the faceless thin-limb missing edge with no reflection opens its external cooling bracket after combustion; T2 the face-hole rim exposes the heat-gate vent after exhaust; T3 the eye orbit and star interior expose a cooling gap between cycles; T4 the partial negative limb exposes the bounded cooling marker after smoke redirects; T5 the unresolved eye-ring exposes its ignition interval between cycles.

Motion/process branches: T1 the thin-limb missing edge briefly loads its external clamp without filling the absence; T2 the face-hole rim commits one load key; T3 eye-orbit pauses transfer star-interior load; T4 the partial negative limb loads and releases one brace; T5 the unresolved eye-ring loads and fractures one interval.

Motion/process branches: T1 the thin-limb missing edge directs debris around one still external gauge; T2 the face-hole rim vents through its channel; T3 eye-orbit pauses redirect star-interior vectors; T4 the partial negative limb moves between still markers; T5 the unresolved eye-ring redirects and stills one pressure interval.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Probe timing with one scuttling route whose final thin limb appears to skip a contact point.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the last matte limb pauses at an open edge even though no reflection confirms its position.
forms.signatureMechanic: Unfinished Step: too many thin limbs scuttle in sequence, but one missing contact makes the body hesitate before the low rake.
forms.telegraph: Three limb tips align while a fourth open edge stops moving against the floor without reflection.
forms.counterplay: Cross the missing-contact side and strike the paused thin-limb edge before the rake resumes.
forms.visualDelta: Low scuttling Crawler of too many thin matte-black limbs with no face and no reflection.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Repeat a humanoid advance that draws attacks toward a smooth face-hole before folding at one blurred edge.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the hole is a false center and the sharpest outer edge carries the committed strike.
forms.signatureMechanic: Empty Regard: the face-hole fixes forward while one blurred shoulder edge becomes sharp enough to cut across its approach.
forms.telegraph: The smooth face-hole narrows while every edge blurs except one shoulder line.
forms.counterplay: Ignore the face-hole, cross the blurred side, and punish the sharp shoulder after it passes.
forms.visualDelta: Humanoid outline with a smooth face-hole and edges that remain slightly blurred.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Crawlers follow the sharp edge; interrupting their missing step reveals the Hollow's real shoulder early.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a geometry controller that folds the arena route differently from its orbiting eye cluster.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach players to read the star-interior gap rather than eye direction and cross before the wrong fold closes.
forms.signatureMechanic: Contradictory Fold: orbiting eyes mark two apparent hinges while the star-flecked interior opens at a third gap and folds the body through that route.
forms.telegraph: The body bends the wrong way, the eye cluster pauses, and one star-field gap widens without an eye above it.
forms.counterplay: Take the eye-less star gap and strike the exposed geometric hinge after the fold.
forms.visualDelta: Wrong-folding body with orbiting clusters of eyes and a star-flecked interior visible through fractured gaps.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Hollows sharpen an apparent hinge; breaking that shoulder exposes the true star gap.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Control alternating arena margins with a vast form only partly present and negative limbs that stop before their endpoints.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the dissolving edge nearest the sharpest star gap is the only committed margin.
forms.signatureMechanic: Before-It-Ends: one negative limb begins beyond the frame, stops before it ends, and subtracts a lane until the adjacent partial edge returns.
forms.telegraph: A vast contour enters only part of the scene while one cold accent marks the partial edge that will return last.
forms.counterplay: Move through the unmarked negative limb and strike the returning partial edge at its cold accent.
forms.visualDelta: Vast shape only partly present, edges dissolving into negative space, and limbs that end before they end.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Fractures fold apparent exits toward the selected margin; breaking their hinge restores one lane.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Phase an arena around an unresolved sovereign absence whose eye ring restages each learned subtraction rule.
forms.teachingGoal: Test missing contacts, false centers, wrong folds, and partial edges while every closed eye group restores one resolvable arena boundary.
forms.signatureMechanic: Arena Phase — Unfinishable Witness: one eye-ring interval opens, the world-shaped absence subtracts a quadrant, and a lower Void Horror performs its learned rule along the last resolvable boundary.
forms.telegraph: A group of unblinking eyes closes in sequence while geometry refuses to resolve around the remaining open interval.
forms.counterplay: Answer the called lower-form subtraction and strike the open eye-ring interval; each closed group restores a boundary and removes one phase route.
forms.visualDelta: Silhouette-shaped absence ringed with unblinking eyes and geometry that remains deliberately unresolved.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Crawler, Hollow, Fracture, and Encroacher each define one eye-ring phase; resolving that form's lesson exposes the associated interval.
